title: Oil Slick Selection
description: Chọn một dòng trong danh sách, một mảng mềm như vệt dầu loang nở ra quanh dòng đó, mép gợn chậm, bên trong là các dải màu óng ánh chảy chéo.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-material-oil-slick, written here): List card 144x128 r12 (rows 42 px apart). The selected row gets a superellipse blob (exponent 4) 124x32, growing from 80 % width / 60 % height on a spring k160 d14 at 0.55 s, edge noise ±5 / ±3.5 px drifting over the 4.2 s cycle, filled with diagonal bands in 5 colours (2 px lines, 8 px apart, slope 0.45, 5 px sine wobble) at 50 % flowing 40 px per 4.2 s; the same bands at 7 % over the card; 1.5 px accent outline. Out 3.55-3.95 s. Params: blob (124x32, k160 c14) · edge noise (±5 / ±3.5 px) · bands (5 màu, 2 px, cách 8 px) · flow (40 px / 4.2 s). A superellipse (exponent 4) grows on a spring k160 c14 with a slowly drifting edge; five-colour diagonal bands flow inside it at 50 % and over the card at 7 %.
